The strongest form of [[Moblin]]s, they attack with powerful [[Bow]] attacks, and can withstand more hits than [[Red Moblin]]s. ==={{TAoL|-}}=== In {{TAoL}}, Blue Moblins are the strongest variety of [[Moblin]]. Like other Moblins, they attack by throwing their [[Spear]]s or jabbing [[Link]] with them, draining his [[Experience Gauge]] if they land a hit on him. ==={{OoS|-}}=== {{Stub|OoS}} ==={{OoA|-}}=== {{Stub|OoA}} ==={{TWW|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= TWW |type= Enemies |category= Enemies in The Wind Waker |needs= Detailed information on the following: * The Enemy's behavior * The Enemy's weaknesses * Where the Enemy appears }} In {{TWW}}, Blue Moblins are first found as a [[Miniboss]] in [[Dragon Roost Cavern]], then appearing as a common [[Enemy]] afterwards. They are fought the same way as regular [[Moblin]]s, but do not wield [[Lantern]]s. ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract|Blue Moblin}} In {{BotW}}, Blue Moblins are found all over [[Hyrule]], being a stronger variation of the regular [[Moblin]]. They are known by their tall and heavyweight stature, and they carry stronger [[Moblin Gear]] and other [[Weapon]]s than their weaker counterparts. When defeated, Blue Moblins drop [[Moblin Horn]]s, [[Moblin Fang]]s, and [[Moblin Guts]]. ====Drops==== {{Collapsible |header= Drops of Blue Moblin |collapse= true |content= {{Tabs |- | Normal | {{Drop Table |game= BotW |- | Moblin Guts | 1 | 80 % |- | Moblin Fang | 1-2 | 80 % |- | Moblin Horn | 1 | 100 % }} |- | FireArrow | {{Drop Table |game= BotW |- | Fire Arrow x5 | 2 | 30 % |- | Moblin Fang | 2 | 70 % |- | Moblin Horn | 1 | 100 % |- | Moblin Guts | 1

They drop [[Blue Moblin Horn]]s upon defeat. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Blue Moblins reappear in {{AoC}}, first seen in the [[Scenario]] "[[The Yiga Clan Attacks!]]". Like Moblins, they attack with either their fists or weapons like [[Moblin Spear]]s, [[Moblin Club]]s, and any metal weapons, which can be [[Countering|Countered]] with the [[Stasis]], [[Cryonis]], and [[Magnesis]] [[Sheikah Rune]]s, thus exposing their [[Weak-Point Gauge]]. When defeated, Blue Moblins drop [[Moblin Fang]]s, [[Moblin Horn]]s, and, rarely, [[Moblin Guts]]. A [[Treasure Chest]] containing a [[Weapon]] may also appear in their place. One [[Moblin Trophy]] will be awarded at the end of a [[Battle]] for each slain Blue Moblin. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Stub|AoI}} Blue Moblins are [[Powerful Enemy|Powerful Enemies]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:TLoZ Blue Moblin Sprite 2.png|{{Game Label|{{TLoZ|-}}}}A Blue Moblin from the side File:BotW Moblin Concept Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Concept artwork of Moblins File:TotK Blue Moblin Model 2.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}A Gloom-Wreathed Blue Moblin File:AoI Blue Moblin.png|{{Game Label|{{AoI|-}}}}A Blue Moblin ==See Also== {{See Also| * Enemy * Moblin * Monster }} {{Ref| {{Cite Book|book= E |page= 193 {{Exp Game|TLoZ, TAoL}}}} {{Cite Guide|TWWHD Prima|page= 100}} {{Cite|'''Blue Moblin'''|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}} {{Cite|These heavyweight monsters can be found all over Hyrule.
